chunks: The day Resurrection is set the sinners will swear: 'We did not tarry more than an hour.' That is how they have always been deceived.

key_terms.يُؤْفَكُونَ: They were deceived/turned away from the truth

ai.seo_question: What will the sinners claim about the duration of their stay on Earth when Resurrection begins?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the psychological delusion of the disbelievers who, overwhelmed by the reality of the Hereafter, attempt to minimize their earthly duration to justify their neglect of duty. This 'deception' (yufakun) refers to the distortion of truth by those who previously mocked the resurrection, now realizing the vast chasm between a fleeting moment and eternal accountability. It serves as a poignant reminder that worldly life, though brief, is the decisive arena for eternal fate.
